title: The Wolfsberg questionnaire is not mandatory; a fallback question set is asked in Hazel onboarding
direction: A bank that does not hold a Wolfsberg questionnaire is not blocked. It answers an equivalent set of questions inside the Hazel onboarding flow instead, and that data is pushed to CoverBase. The questions are asked by the Hazel-built onboarding rather than by CoverBase directly. A bank that does hold a Wolfsberg document continues on the existing path.
reasoning: Recorded as DEC-001 from the 2026-07-27 meeting, decided by Joel Olivares.
acceptance_criteria: A spec change exists in react-frontend covering the behaviour in DEC-001, in the step-03-documents area.
Every requirement added or modified by that change cites [DEC-001] in its requirement text.
Each new or modified requirement has at least one scenario.
The implementation satisfies the changed spec, and the PR references this issue.

evidence.excerpt: Yeah, I think that would be our best approach. Now, I can incorporate some of those questions into Cover Base, but I believe it's better if they come from the Hazel onboarding that the team is working on.
